final_topology.title: Hierarchical Network Architecture
final_topology.description: A secure hierarchical network with an Internet Edge, a three-tier data center, and WAN connections to remote sites.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology includes an Internet Edge with a firewall and application-layer security, a three-tier data center, and WAN links to a regional and branch office with local routing and switching.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an Asset Management System (n24) that manages inventory for multiple nodes across different zones, indicating a detailed and maintained asset inventory.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Data Flow Documentation Server (n_new1) that sends data flow documentation to the SIEM (n13), indicating that data flows are documented.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Sensitive Data Zone (z6) and a Non-Production Zone (z7), indicating that data processing and storage are segmented based on sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes firewalls (n25, n26, n27) in the Data Center (z2) zone, indicating that firewalls are implemented and managed on servers.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a DNS Server (n14) in the Internet Edge (z1) zone, which is used by various nodes, indicating that trusted DNS servers are configured on enterprise assets.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an MFA/Identity Server (n15) that verifies MFA for the Remote Access VPN Gateway (n10), indicating that MFA is required for remote network access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a DNS Filtering Appliance (n16) that filters DNS requests, indicating that DNS filtering services are used.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a URL Filtering Appliance (n28) that enforces URL filtering, indicating that network-based URL filters are maintained and enforced.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes a hierarchical network with an Internet Edge, a three-tier data center, and WAN connections to remote sites, indicating a secure network architecture.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an IaC Management server (n29) that manages infrastructure, indicating that network infrastructure is securely managed.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Centralized AAA Server (n18) that integrates with the Remote Access VPN Gateway (n10), indicating centralized network AAA.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Remote Access VPN Gateway (n10) that authenticates to the Centralized AAA Server (n18), indicating that remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes an IDS/IPS (n12) and NIDS/NIPS sensors (n19, n20) that send data to the SIEM (n13), indicating that a network intrusion detection solution is deployed.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes firewalls (n25, n26, n27) that segment the Data Center (z2) and perform traffic filtering between segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a NAC Appliance (n21) that controls access to the Remote Access VPN Gateway (n10), indicating that access control for remote assets is managed.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Flow Log Collector (n22) that collects flow logs and sends them to the SIEM (n13), indicating that network traffic flow logs are collected.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Non-Production Zone (z7) and a Sensitive Data Zone (z6), indicating that production and non-production systems are separated.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Pen Testing Service (n30) that performs penetration testing and sends reports to the Pen Test Report Repository (n_new2), indicating that periodic external penetration tests are performed.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various nodes and zones, but there is no explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset management system and links to all other nodes.

findings_before.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a firewall (n1) but does not explicitly show firewalls on servers.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of firewalls on servers.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add firewall nodes to the Web Server (n3), Application Server (n4), and Database Server (n5).

findings_before.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not explicitly show a network-based URL filtering system.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of network-based URL filtering.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a URL filtering appliance and links to relevant nodes.

findings_before.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various network devices (routers, switches, firewalls) but does not explicitly show secure management practices such as version-controlled IaC or secure network protocols.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of secure management practices.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add nodes and links representing secure management practices, such as version-controlled IaC and secure network protocols.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an External Testing Zone (z8) but does not explicitly show evidence of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a penetration testing service and links to relevant nodes.

findings_before.title: Document Data Flows
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes multiple data flow links, but there is no explicit documentation of these data flows. A human review is needed to confirm if data flow documentation exists.
findings_before.missing_reason: Explicit documentation of data flows is not present in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add explicit documentation of data flows in the topology.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a Pen Testing Service (n30) in the External Testing Zone (z10) with a link (nl45) for Pen Testing, but there is no explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests being performed. A human review is needed to confirm if periodic external penetration tests are conducted.
findings_before.missing_reason: Explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests is not present in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add explicit documentation or evidence of periodic external penetration tests in the topology.
